visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with long dark hair, wearing a black beanie and a vibrant, geometrically patterned multi-colored fleece jacket, performs precise martial arts-inspired movements in a modern urban plaza. He starts by facing the camera directly, pushing his palms outward toward the lens with intense focus, set against a backdrop of city pavement and distant greenery under bright natural light. (2) He rotates his torso fluidly towards a large outdoor installation, extending his arms in a controlled, rhythmic fashion that suggests internal power and discipline. The background features a large, snowy-themed decorative board with bold Traditional Chinese characters and illustrations of prehistoric creatures, illuminated by the clear midday sun which creates sharp shadows on the ground. (3) The performer continues his sequence of dynamic poses, lunging forward on an area of artificial green turf while pushing his hands toward a life-sized, dark-colored Velociraptor dinosaur statue. The handheld camera follows his circular motions, capturing the contrast between his colorful attire and the detailed textures of the stationary dinosaur model in the foreground. (4) As he transitions through another set of expansive arm motions, the background reveals more of the surrounding cityscape, including modern glass-facade high-rise buildings and a sleek pedestrian bridge. His black trousers and dark sneakers are visible as he maintains a low, stable stance throughout the energetic movement sequence, ending with a final assertive posture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Dramatic cinematic orchestral music starts instantly, featuring a prominent, driving string section and rhythmic percussion that establishes a heroic and intense atmosphere. The tempo is steady and moderately fast, with a dark, minor-key tonal framework that suggests action and narrative tension from the opening second. (2) A sharp, high-frequency 'whoosh' sound effect is triggered as a transient event, meticulously synchronized with a fast, circular hand movement seen on screen. The background music continues unabated, providing a lush, textured bed of orchestral strings and muted brass that swells slightly in spectral brightness. (3) A second, distinct synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect occurs, exhibiting a slightly different frequency sweep than the first, yet remaining perfectly aligned with the rhythmic movement of the performer's limbs. There are no audible human voices, narration, or background chatter, leaving the mix focused on the score and effects. (4) The orchestral progression reaches a peak with increased harmonic tension and stronger percussive accents during the final sequence of movements. The acoustic environment remains clean and professional, with minimal urban noise interference, and the track ends with a sharp hard cut as the video concludes.
